scientific_integrity: Analytical flip-forest and coarea proof; finite computations are supplementary. No independent mathematical audit or uniqueness certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite, simple, unweighted trees and synchronous neighbor-majority median with inertia at even degrees. Sharp global supremum ranges over trees of fixed order. Not a two-input Lipschitz or fixed-tree classification; no weighted-edge or arbitrary-graph claim. Existing literature was compared but latent prior equivalence remains possible.
title: Sharp finite-order variation amplification by tree majority-median filters
